sessions.phase_label: Revision-scope dispute and outstanding design clarification
Bluehaven portfolio completion and asset-specific clarification

requirements.title: Business Portfolio Collection
requirements.definition: Create the requested collection of five business portfolios.
requirements.boundary_note: The portfolio count is an attribute of the collection-level obligation. The specifically named Bluehaven Aviation portfolio is separated because it can be delivered and revised independently.

requirements.title: Brochure Collection
requirements.definition: Create the requested collection of seven to nine brochures.
requirements.boundary_note: The seven-to-nine quantity is an attribute of one brochure-collection obligation. The unconfirmed suggestion to package the brochures into three PDFs is not included.

requirements.title: Business Pitch Content with Images
requirements.definition: Develop business-pitch content incorporating relevant pictures.
requirements.boundary_note: Pitch content is independent from the portfolio and brochure artifacts and can be developed or revised separately. Scheduling language about developing it later is excluded.

requirements.title: Aircraft-Tailored High-Impact Visual Direction
requirements.definition: Apply an exclusive aircraft-tailored visual treatment based on the supplied reference, with less text and greater visual impact.
requirements.boundary_note: This captures the shared creative direction rather than the quantities or substantive content of individual artifacts. Unaccepted freelancer suggestions about colors and storyline are not treated as confirmed attributes.

requirements.title: Social Media Content
requirements.definition: Create a small number of social-media content pieces for the business.
requirements.boundary_note: Social-media content is independently deliverable from portfolios, brochures, and pitch content. Instagram and Facebook applicability remains unconfirmed and is not assumed.

requirements.title: Bluehaven Aviation Portfolio
requirements.definition: Produce the specifically named Bluehaven Aviation portfolio.
requirements.boundary_note: This named portfolio is separated from the overall portfolio-count constraint because later work and delivery can target it alone. The associated funding language is excluded.

requirements.title: Dark Treatment for Image Seven
requirements.definition: Apply the requested dark visual treatment to image seven, subject to resolution of the freelancer's aesthetic concern.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept as a provisional independent asset-level requirement because the treatment can be changed or clarified separately; the evidence does not identify which larger deliverable contains image seven.

unresolved_candidates.description: The social-media platform scope is unresolved because the freelancer asks whether the content is for Instagram, Facebook, or both, and no client answer is supplied.
The relationship among the seven-to-nine brochures, portfolio items, social posts, and possible packaging into three PDF files is questioned but never authoritatively resolved.
Color-reference and deliverable-dimension questions are unanswered, so no concrete palette or size requirement can be established.

The freelancer states that the original agreed scope covered image design only, which conflicts with earlier client requests for pitch and social-media content; the resulting lifecycle impact on those content obligations is unresolved.
The parent portfolio, brochure, or other artifact containing image seven cannot be identified from the supplied evidence.
